status: Source guard repair validated; forward qualification design pending
area: Historical delivery eligibility / WIP recovery / taskflow readiness
finding: Explicit historical delivery references bypassed the WIP filter used by automatic discovery. Discovery itself ignored ATM-Closeout-Eligible: false. Separately, a clean taskflow preview claimed delivery had already landed even when no eligible historical commit was found. Preserved work could therefore be misrepresented as formal delivery, while genuine WIP-only completion had no clear forward qualification route.
expectedBehavior: Use one eligibility gate for explicit refs, planning-card refs, and discovery. Reject ATM-WIP: true, ATM-Delivery: false, and ATM-Closeout-Eligible: false before considering scope waivers. Ineligible or unreadable commits supply no deliverable files or matched buckets to close guards. Readiness must distinguish a verified delivery ref from no qualified delivery and direct unfinished work back through the governed task route without suggesting a WIP SHA or artificial edits. Resolve planning-authority delivery refs in the same repository selected by the close backend.
evidenceOrRepro: tests/cli/validate-cli-historical-delivery.test.ts reproduces explicit-ref acceptance before repair and covers each marker, case/whitespace variants, conflicting duplicate trailers, scope-waiver rejection, planning-card discovery parity, metadata-read failure, and valid delivery/empty-message positive controls. It also runs tests/cli/taskflow-non-delivery-readiness.test.ts, which covers a clean WIP-only history, explicit WIP refs, multiple refs, real uncommitted work, and valid historical delivery. Two-repo cases accept planning-only delivery SHAs, reject target-only substitution, and reject non-closeable planning WIP. All four reproduced failures were observed before their correction and pass after it. Targeted lint, typecheck, and existing readiness/mixed-delivery/WIP-recovery suites pass. The standard aggregate remains failed: bootstrap packaging exceeds its path budget and skew smoke reports governance-entry-readiness; this is not a full validation or release claim.
followUp: The existing release-WIP route preserves interrupted source with non-delivery trailers; it does not define a validation-backed promotion operation. Continuing real scoped work can use ordinary delivery, but completed unchanged WIP needs a separately reviewed forward qualification contract bound to task, claim, exact source tree, declared file inventory, current validation evidence, and immutable WIP provenance. Do not relabel, rewrite, or directly close against the original WIP commit; do not add no-op code merely to manufacture a delivery diff. Frozen publication and formal lifecycle closure remain separate from this source repair.
